name: Ahmed Body 3D · 25° · Re 2.784 million
description: Three-dimensional SST external aerodynamics with a 25° rear slant, R100 faceted forebody, ground clearance and wake section.

expectations.notes: The R100 forebody is approximated by eight ruled stations; the 25-degree slant and principal dimensions are retained. Mounting supports are omitted and the ground is stationary. Inspect body/ground y+ before comparing drag.

sources.title: Meile et al.: Experiments and Numerical Simulations on the Aerodynamics of the Ahmed Body
sources.notes: Use matching Reynolds number, stationary ground and 25° configuration. Forebody is faceted; mounting supports are omitted.

sources.title: Bayraktar, Landman & Baysal: Experimental and Computational Investigation of Ahmed Body

comparisons.procedure: Use body-only integrated force and Aref=0.389×0.288 m². Compare a matching experiment after force stabilization and mesh refinement.
Compare normalized XZ midplane wake velocity at the published downstream stations.
